ee975fa566b4.summary: crates/conformance/src/lib.rs was changed by 2 fixes in 180 days, and no registered promise's check covers it
ee975fa566b4.why: Both fixes change this file only by registering a new scenario in suite! (factum#8: a_writer_that_loses_every_race_gives_up, SPEC §7's 1000-loss bound; f499aec: a_result_whose_lease_ran_out_meanwhile_is_refused and a_wake_while_a_runner_holds_the_process_is_not_lost). The file is the conformance test registry; the promises it registers are checked by those scenarios (tests), whose code truefit cannot see.
